footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $632K income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.9% to $349M in 2025. Gross margin was 44.2%, versus 46.1% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $30.2M from $42.5M.
The net loss narrowed to $22.7M, or −$0.86 per share, from $35.9M. Operating cash flow was −$11.2M and free cash flow −$13.7M, versus $2.6M.
sources: Inogen, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We operate in a rapidly changing environment that involves numerous uncertainties and risks
We operate in a highly competitive industry and we may be unable to compete effectively
We depend on a limited number of customers for a significant portion of our sales revenue
Reduction or interruption in our supply of components and products may adversely affect our manufacturing operations and related product sales
Tariffs, trade restrictions and Section 232 investigations could increase our costs and disrupt our supply chain
If we are unable to continue to enhance our existing products, develop or acquire and market products that respond to customer needs…
strategy: Grow our core business. We believe we have an opportunity to drive penetration of POC-based oxygen therapy versus other oxygen therapy modalities
Support adoption of Inogen products through clinical evidence and key opinion leaders' advocacy
